why: Lessons address vocabulary by headword; these headwords name more than one record and no stored evidence (sibling ref, lesson level, introducing topic) singled one out. Each row is ONE lesson's decision; `affects` says where the ref occurs (unlock and/or body). 'frequency' rows were settled by sentence-bank reading counts; 'unresolved' rows had nothing to go on and took the lowest JMdict entry. Both need a teacher to confirm the sense the lesson teaches.
